acholi.tour.note_taking_text:
Template me coyo ngec ma pwonyo jo akwena *kit ma* gicoyo ki ngec, pe ngo ma gicoyo keken.

### Pro Tip
• Ket *Cornell Notes* kacel ki **Adapted Text**: latin kwan gicoyo ngec i rwom kwan mamegi, ci gitiyo ki bok me summary piny calo ngiyo apim i cawa me pwony.

chin_falam.tour.note_taking_text:
A hringthar mi note cawnhnak template, sianginn rakkhuh nih *zeitindah* note cawn an cawng kha.

### Pro Tip
• *Cornell Notes* le **Adapted Text** kha pehtlai tein hman: sianginn ngakchia nih an siar khawhning level ah note an cawnh, cun a tang summary box kha formative assessment zohfelnak ah hman.

chin_hakha.tour.note_taking_text:
A hringthar mi note cawnhnak template, hin nih sianginn rakkhuh nih *zeitindah* note cawn a si bantuk an cawng kha *zeidah* an ttial a sina lo.

### Pro Tip
• *Cornell Notes* le **Adapted Text** kha pehtlai tein hman: sianginn caa nih an siar khawhning level ah note an cawnh, cun a tang summary box kha formative assessment zohfelnak ah hman.

karen.tour.note_taking_text:
တၢ်ကွဲးနၢ်ပၢၢ်ပြၤလၢပျၤထီၣ်ဖိသၣ်ဘၢၣ်ၣ်ၣ်

### Pro Tip
• *Cornell Notes* ဒီး **Adapted Text** တပူၤဃီန့ၣ် ကၠိဖိတဖၣ်ကွဲးနီၣ်တၢ်လၢအဖးတီၢ်အပူၤ ဒီးသူ summary box လၢတၢ်သမံသမိးအဂီၢ်.

lingala.tour.note_taking_text:
Bilembo ya kokoma oyo eteyaka bana ya kelasi *ndenge nini* ya kokoma, te kaka *nini* ya kokoma.

### Toli ya Mayele
• Sangisa *Cornell Notes* na **Makomi Ebongisami**: bayekoli bakomaka banoti na niveau na bango ya kotanga, mpe basalelaka esika ya bokuse mpo na botali ya formative assessment.

marshallese.tour.note_taking_text:
Template ko ñan kōṃṃan note rej katakin ri-jikuuḷ *ekōjkan* aer kōṃṃan note, jab baj wōt *ta* eo aer je.

### Pro Tip
• Kōjerbal *Cornell Notes* ippān **Adapted Text**: rūkkatak ro rej kōṃṃan note ilo level in riit eo aer, innem kōjerbal summary box ñan formative-assessment check.
